Wow, Fall's here… I can't believe Summer is finally over!
...
Stop taking out your Christmas decorations, please.
Chapter 6 is progressing well.
The game is now a structurally complete draft that can be
played from the beginning to the end. All the maps, events, and
battles exist. (Although there's still one optional event which
is dragging out a bit…)
By the time you read this, we should have started the
localization and some preliminary testing. Much of the game
looks complete… but, some important scenes and details are
still undercooked in their presentation, so it's going to take
a bit longer before we can really move to full-on testing.
Even though Chapter 6 is a rather short chapter, I would like
it to be as good as possible. I won't be able to rush this.
Your votes are IN!
Queen won!!!
Your reward is seeing this stupid scene from Ch6.
Well, we've only just started…
I read out the events and dialogue of Chapter 7 to the team.
However, just when the story reached a critical moment, I
stopped reading… I told my team they need to complete more
of the game before I tell them what happens.
Everyone agrees it's more fun this way.
Team members who completed their work on Chapter 6 have
moved onto Chapter 7 now. Unlike every other Chapter, I
actually feel like I know what I'm doing this time, so I have a
lot of confidence...!
An extremely long time ago, I had my friend Marina design a
character for Chapter 5 named Apple Girlington. She would've
been a shopkeeper in the first area who sells you her
delicious apples. It goes without saying, but she gets angry if
you don't like her delicious apples…
In the end I felt like she overlapped too much with Pink, so I
decided not to include her in the game. Plus, apples grew to
have some other meanings in the game's story so it would've
been a bit strange.
That being said, she had an amazing character design and
Marina drew her many times over the years, so go check out
all the drawings!!!
A new DELTARUNE piano collection by Trevor Alan Gomes has
come out. The music from the last piano collection was used
as credits for Ch5... so, I'm excited to listen and look!
They did something.
I think I say this every time, but with the team expanded since
Chapter 4, more and more time is necessary to keep DELTARUNE
developing at the fastest pace possible. I know it's probably
annoying to not have any updates, but no news is good news.
I'll update everyone again when the localization of Chapter 6
is finished!
